tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# Attempt to restore the CoreDNS deployment by restarting it in the kube-system namespace
# This forces Kubernetes to roll out new pods based on the existing configuration, which often resolves unhealthy probe states.
kubectl rollout restart deployment coredns -n kube-system

# Wait a few seconds for the rollout to start
sleep 10

# Check the status of the CoreDNS deployment
kubectl get deployments coredns -n kube-system

# Check the status of the CoreDNS pods to see if they transition to Ready and Running
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns
"}

{"command":"# Attempt to restore the CoreDNS deployment by restarting it in the kube-system namespace
# This forces Kubernetes to roll out new pods based on the existing configuration, which often resolves unhealthy probe states.
kubectl rollout restart deployment coredns -n kube-system

# Wait a few seconds for the rollout to start
sleep 10

# Check the status of the CoreDNS deployment
kubectl get deployments coredns -n kube-system

# Check the status of the CoreDNS pods to see if they transition to Ready and Running
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns
"}
